summary: Trap: 130–160 BPM felt half-time, rolling 16th/32nd hats, booming 808 bass, dark minor melodies on bells or plucks
body: Drums: snare or clap on 3 (half-time), kick syncopated with the 808, hats in 16ths with 32nd and triplet rolls.
Bass: the 808 is a long, low sine-like note with slides, following the kick; it is the loudest thing.
Harmony: minor, often just i–VI or i–iv–v; a short melody on bells, plucks, a choir or strings, dark and sparse.
Space: little reverb on drums, more on the melody.

Apply: pattern/trap-halftime on the drums, then pattern/prog-trap-characteristic-1 on the keys four bars later. It leaves tempo and sounds to you: move the tempo toward 130–160 gradually, and swap sounds from the links.

drums.about: the drum track (a kit); leave out if there isn't one

keys.about: a chordal part (keys, pad); leave out if there isn't one
